    - get: O(1)
    - min: O(log N) amortized (lazy deletion)
    - max: O(log N) amortized (lazy deletion)
    - size: O(1)
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._data: Dict[Any, Any] = {}
        self._min_heap: list[Tuple[Any, Any]] = []  # (value, key)
        self._max_heap: list[Tuple[Any, Any]] = []  # (-value, key) for max
        self._deleted: set[Any] = set()  # keys that have been deleted

    def insert(self, key: Any, value: Any) -> None:
        """Insert or update a key-value pair. O(1) time."""
        if key in self._data:
            # Mark old entry as deleted in heaps
            self._deleted.add(key)
        self._data[key] = value
        heapq.heappush(self._min_heap, (value, key))
        heapq.heappush(self._max_heap, (-value, key))

    def delete(self, key: Any) -> bool:
        """Delete a key. Returns True if key existed, False otherwise. O(1) time."""
        if key not in self._data:
            return False
        del self._data[key]
        self._deleted.add(key)
        return True

    def get(self, key: Any) -> Optional[Any]:
        """Get value for key. Returns None if not found. O(1) time."""
        return self._data.get(key)

    def _clean_min_heap(self) -> None:
        """Remove deleted entries from the top of the min-heap. O(log N) amortized."""
        while self._min_heap:
            value, key = self._min_heap[0]
            if key in self._deleted or key not in self._data or self._data[key] != value:
                heapq.heappop(self._min_heap)
            else:
                break

    def _clean_max_heap(self) -> None:
        """Remove deleted entries from the top of the max-heap. O(log N) amortized."""
        while self._max_heap:
            neg_value, key = self._max_heap[0]
            value = -neg_value
            if key in self._deleted or key not in self._data or self._data[key] != value:
                heapq.heappop(self._max_heap)
            else:
                break

    def min(self) -> Optional[Any]:
        """
        Get the minimum value. Returns None if the structure is empty.
        O(log N) amortized time due to lazy deletion cleanup.
        """
        self._clean_min_heap()
        if not self._min_heap:
            return None
        return self._min_heap[0][0]

    def max(self) -> Optional[Any]:
        """
        Get the maximum value. Returns None if the structure is empty.
        O(log N) amortized time due to lazy deletion cleanup.
        """
        self._clean_max_heap()
        if not self._max_heap:
            return None
        return -self._max_heap[0][0]

    def size(self) -> int:
        """Get the number of elements. O(1) time."""
        return len(self._data)
